cards.ex: Even though everyone disagreed, she stuck to her guns about the importance of the project.
cards.exUz: Hamma norozi bo'lishiga qaramay, u loyihaning muhimligi haqida o'z fikrida qoldi.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikringizdan qat'iy turish, o'z pozitsiyangizni himoya qilish.

cards.ex: The ownership of the land has been a bone of contention between the two families for years.
cards.exUz: Yer egaligi ikki oila o'rtasida yillar davomida bahs mavzusi bo'lib kelgan.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy kelishmovchilik yoki bahsga sabab bo'ladigan narsa.

cards.ex: I have to take issue with your statement that all teenagers are irresponsible.
cards.exUz: Men sizning barcha o'smirlar mas'uliyatsiz degan gapingizga norozilik bildirmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga rozi bo'lmaslik, e'tiroz bildirish.

cards.ex: Be that as it may, I still think we should consider other options.
cards.exUz: Shunday bo'lsa ham, menimcha biz boshqa variantlarni ko'rib chiqishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Garchi shunday bo'lsa ham, lekin boshqa bir fikr ham bor.

cards.ex: My brother and I don't always see eye to eye on politics.
cards.exUz: Aka-ukam siyosat haqida har doim bir xil fikrda bo'lmaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil fikrga ega bo'lish, kelishuvga erishish.

cards.ex: In my humble opinion, the movie was overrated.
cards.exUz: Mening kamtarona fikrimcha, film juda yuqori baholangan.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrini kamtarlik bilan bildirish.

cards.ex: On the one hand, I want to travel, but on the other hand, I need to save money.
cards.exUz: Bir tomondan, men sayohat qilishni xohlayman, lekin ikkinchi tomondan, pulni tejashim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Bir tomondan, bitta fikrni bildirish.

cards.ex: I beg to differ, I think the evidence points to a different conclusion.
cards.exUz: Men qarshiman, menimcha dalillar boshqa xulosaga ishora qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Fikringizga qo'shilmaslikni hurmat bilan bildirish.

cards.ex: Don't jump to conclusions, let's hear what she has to say first.
cards.exUz: Xulosa qilishga shoshilmang, avval uning nima deyishini eshitaylik.
cards.uzDef: Dalillarni ko'rib chiqmasdan tezda xulosa chiqarish.

cards.ex: For argument's sake, let's say you're right. What happens then?
cards.exUz: Bahs uchun, deylik, siz haqsiz. Keyin nima bo'ladi?
cards.uzDef: Faqat bahslashish uchun biror fikrni qabul qilish.

cards.ex: The best approach is still open to debate.
cards.exUz: Eng yaxshi yondashuv hali ham muhokama uchun ochiq.
cards.uzDef: Bahslashishga tayyor bo'lgan mavzu.

cards.ex: He held his ground during the heated debate.
cards.exUz: U qizg'in bahsda o'z pozitsiyasini saqlab qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsada qat'iy turish, o'z fikringizdan chekinmaslik.

cards.ex: I don't hate it, on the contrary, I quite like it!
cards.exUz: Men uni yomon ko'rmayman, aksincha, menga juda yoqadi!
cards.uzDef: Avval aytilgan fikrga zid bo'lgan fikrni bildirish.

cards.ex: Whether he's guilty or not is now a moot point since he's already left the country.
cards.exUz: Uning aybdor yoki aybdor emasligi endi muhim bo'lmagan masala, chunki u allaqachon mamlakatni tark etgan.
cards.uzDef: Amalda muhim ahamiyatga ega bo'lmagan savol.

cards.ex: In the long run, this decision will benefit the company.
cards.exUz: Uzoq muddatda bu qaror kompaniyaga foyda keltiradi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida, kelajakda.

cards.ex: That's a valid point, I hadn't thought of it that way.
cards.exUz: Bu o'rinli fikr, men bu haqda o'ylamagan edim.
cards.uzDef: E'tiborga loyiq bo'lgan fikr.

cards.ex: I can see both sides of the argument, it's a tough decision.
cards.exUz: Men bahsning ikkala tomonini ham ko'ra olaman, bu qiyin qaror.
cards.uzDef: Muammoning ikkala tomonini ham tushunish.

cards.ex: Allowing them to stay out late is a slippery slope; soon they'll want to do whatever they want.
cards.exUz: Ularga kechgacha yurishga ruxsat berish - sirpanchiq yo'l; tez orada ular xohlagan narsani qilishni xohlashadi.
cards.uzDef: Bitta xato ketma-ket boshqa xatolarga olib kelishi mumkin.

cards.ex: I agree with you to some extent, but I still have reservations.
cards.exUz: Men sizga qisman qo'shilaman, lekin hali ham shubhalarim bor.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lum darajada, to'liq emas.

cards.ex: We need to consider the other side of the coin before making a decision.
cards.exUz: Qaror qabul qilishdan oldin masalaning ikkinchi tomonini ko'rib chiqishimiz kerak.
cards.term: the other side of the coin
cards.uzDef: Muammoning boshqa jihati, boshqa nuqtai nazar.

cards.ex: You have to stand your ground and tell him 'no'.
cards.exUz: Siz o'z pozitsiyangizda turishingiz va unga 'yo'q' deyishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikringizni qat'iy himoya qiling, chekinmang.

cards.ex: For what it's worth, I think you should apologize.
cards.exUz: Qadri qancha bo'lsa ham, menimcha siz kechirim so'rashingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Fikringiz muhim bo'lmasligi mumkinligini aytib, maslahat berish.

cards.ex: Everyone has a right to their own point of view.
cards.exUz: Har bir inson o'z nuqtai nazariga ega bo'lish huquqiga ega.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga bo'lgan shaxsiy fikr yoki qarash.

cards.ex: We need to find a way to settle this argument peacefully.
cards.exUz: Biz bu bahsni tinch yo'l bilan hal qilish yo'lini topishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kelishmovchilikni tugatish, murosaga kelish.

cards.ex: It's not always about winning an argument, sometimes it's about understanding.
cards.exUz: Har doim ham bahsda g'alaba qozonish muhim emas, ba'zan tushunish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Bahsda o'z fikrini isbotlay olish.

cards.ex: I hate to lose an argument, but sometimes you just have to admit you're wrong.
cards.exUz: Men bahsda yutqazishni yomon ko'raman, lekin ba'zan siz xato qilganingizni tan olishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Bahsda o'z fikrini isbotlay olmaslik.

cards.ex: To put it another way, we need to increase our efficiency.
cards.exUz: Boshqacha qilib aytsak, biz samaradorligimizni oshirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Fikringizni tushunarliroq qilish uchun boshqacha so'zlar bilan ifodalash.

cards.ex: On what grounds are you making that accusation?
cards.exUz: Siz bu ayblovni qaysi asosda qo'ymoqdasiz?
cards.uzDef: Nima sababdan, nima uchun degan ma'noda savol berish.

cards.ex: The bottom line is, we can't afford to do it.
cards.exUz: Asosiysi shundaki, biz buni qila olmaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Muhim narsaning qisqacha mazmuni, asosiy fikr.

cards.ex: Losing the game was a hard pill to swallow.
cards.exUz: O'yinda mag'lub bo'lishni qabul qilish qiyin edi.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilish yoki tushunish qiyin bo'lgan haqiqat.
